# tuna_endpoint (Resource)

A static TCP endpoint with a permanent address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tuna_endpoint" "db" {
  alias = "staging-postgres"
}

output "db_address" {
  value = "${tuna_endpoint.db.hostname}:${tuna_endpoint.db.port}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Endpoint alias (DNS label).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `hostname` (String) Hostname assigned to the endpoint.
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `port` (Number) TCP port assigned to the endpoint.
- `type` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tuna_endpoint.db 123
```
